name: Alpha Circuit
old_description: Where signal integrity, thermal control, and reliability converge
about:
Alpha Circuit is headquartered in Elmhurst, Illinois. The company is certified as a Minority Business Enterprise (MBE) and holds ITAR registration for defense-related work.

The company manufactures high-performance printed circuit boards with a focus on signal integrity, thermal management, and reliability. Its vertically integrated operation controls materials, processes, and inspection at every stage to deliver repeatable outcomes for RF and microwave systems, high-speed digital architectures, and multilayer designs engineered for heat dissipation. The firm describes its approach as "process is the product," emphasizing that discipline, not equipment lists, defines capability.

Alpha Circuit serves space-based, defense, and medical programs that require absolute stability. Customers include organizations building systems where failure is not an option, such as satellite payloads, radar modules, and implantable medical devices.

The company was started to close the gap between advanced design and real-world manufacturing. It emphasizes early partnership, systemic thinking, and relentless execution to deliver solutions that perform in demanding environments. Full traceability from incoming material to final test is maintained as a standard practice.
